title: INDIAai
summary:
INDIAai is a web portal and the National AI Portal of India, jointly started by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), the National e-Governance Division (NeGD), and the National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM) with support from the Department of School Education and Literacy and the Ministry of Human Resource Development.

The portal was launched on 30 May 2020 by Ravi Shankar Prasad, the Union Minister for Electronics and IT, Law and Justice and Communications, on the first anniversary of the second tenure of Prime Minister Narendra Modi-led government. A national program for the youth, Responsible AI for Youth, was also launched on the same day. It is the single central knowledge hub on artificial intelligence and allied fields such as Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Deep Learning, aiming to function as a one-stop portal for all AI-related development in India.

As of 2022, the website was visited by more than 4.5 lakh users with 1.2 million page views. It has 1,151 articles on artificial intelligence, 701 news stories, 98 reports, 95 case studies and 213 videos on its portal. It maintains a database on AI ecosystem of India featuring 121 government initiatives and 281 startups. In May 2022, INDIAai released a book titled AI for Everyone that covers the basics of AI.

The Cabinet chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi has approved the comprehensive national-level IndiaAI mission with a budget outlay of Rs.10,371.92 crore, to be implemented by IndiaAI Independent Business Division under Digital India Corporation. Frequent collaborators include government entities, state governments of Telangana and Tamil Nadu, private companies such as IBM, Microsoft, NVIDIA, Meta, Fractal, and Tech Mahindra, and academic institutes such as IIT Madras, IIT Jodhpur, and IIT Ropar.
